game: TB @ HOU, Week 2 2025, kickoff 2025-09-15 19:00 ET, NRG roof closed, HOU -2.5, total 42.5

script.base: Market prices a close, low-event dome game: HOU 22.5, TB 20.0, spread only 2.5 so no blowout and no 3.5+ underdog-pass flag. Both week-1 rush defenses were stingy (HOU 3.22 YPC and 0 runs of 10+; TB 2.59 YPC), so the base lean is run-tilted but inefficient, with HOU slightly ahead late and Chubb the clock back if they lead. TB, without LT Tristan Wirfs, cannot repeat a clean rushing day; Mayfield's extra throws stay short because the tackle is out, not because this is a shootout.
script.flip1: HOU gets up early, Chubb's carries rise, TB abandons the run so Irving's rush line dies, and Mayfield's extra dropbacks still don't become explosives with Wirfs out — short targets (Shepard, Irving, Otton) rather than Evans/Egbuka bombs.
script.flip2: TB hangs or leads, both pass rates rise above the 42.5 script, concentrated WR groups (Godwin/Kirk/Berrios out) clear modest receiving lines, and Chubb never gets the late clock-kill carries.

injury_fallout: Pre-game nflverse injury report, not inactives (those are ~90 min pre-kick and are not in the pack). HOU WR Christian Kirk Out (hamstring) and WR Braxton Berrios Out (hamstring): vacated WR targets fall to Nico Collins (wk1 5 tgt/25 yds/35 air, co-leader), Jayden Higgins (3/32/52), Xavier Hutchinson (2/30/29, no prop), Dalton Schultz (5/28/25) and Cade Stover (4/22/9). HOU C Jake Andrews Out (ankle): interior run fit worse for Chubb/Pierce. TB WR Chris Godwin Jr. Out (ankle): Evans (8/51/106 air), Egbuka (6/67/71) and Shepard (6/39/86) absorb; no separate 'when Godwin sat' share is in the pack beyond this one week. TB T Tristan Wirfs Out (knee) and G Luke Goedeke Questionable (foot): pressure up, rush efficiency down, more quick throws — Irving rush and deep WR yards lose, RB/slot/TE catches gain. TB S Christian Izien and CB Benjamin Morrison are Questionable only; do not count them out. No HOU defensive injuries listed, so no confirmed backup corner/LB for a TE/slot leak.

matchup.overlap: Irving, TB's carry leader (14), runs into the front that allowed zero 10+ runs. Collins is HOU's co-primary target into a secondary that was sticky left (3.91) and loose right (11.41); side alignment is not charted, so that overlap is unconfirmed. Chubb into TB's 2.59 YPC front is a negative overlap and is not a leg. Evans/Egbuka's week-1 air yards (106 and 71) would want HOU's left-side 15.12 YPA, but Wirfs out cuts the deep path.

form: Only 2025 week 1 exists (weeks < 2). All stand-in 'last4' medians are that one game. Irving 14/37 (2.64 YPC) plus 4 targets/8 yards — inefficient lead back, not a fluky long run. White 2/14 and Pierce 3/5 are change-of-pace. Chubb 13/60 (4.62 YPC) and 0 receiving; that efficiency is the number the 60.5 line copies, opponent unnamed. Collins 5/25 on 35 air is a quiet WR1 day sitting on the 25.5 line. Higgins 3/32 on 52 air and Egbuka 6/67 on 71 air look chunk-inflated. Evans 8/51 on 106 air and Shepard 6/39 on 86 air were inefficient deep usages. No similar-defense or new-OC split is in the pack.

pro_edge.implied_totals: HOU 22.5, TB 20.0 = (42.5±2.5)/2, matches PRO-EDGE INPUTS. Low total favors unders and run-heavy play, not volume overs. Spread 2.5 is under the 3.5 underdog-throws-more flag. No blowout flag, so starter snaps are not an automatic cut; leader-runs-late is only a mild Chubb carry lean.
pro_edge.script_read: Build usage from shares, not raw averages: Irving had 14 of TB's non-QB carries (White 2, Egbuka 1) so he is the rush share; Chubb 13 of HOU RB carries (Pierce 3, Marks 3). A 20-point TB total plus a missing left tackle caps Irving more than it creates a pass-funnel. A 22.5 HOU total can still clear a 25.5 WR line on usage concentration without needing a shootout.
pro_edge.best_price: No two-sided price saved on any prop. Anchor no-vig N/A (Pinnacle/Circa/BetOnline not in the pack). No book, price, or timestamp to shop. Alt no-vig cannot be computed. No stake: no model p that beats a no-vig by 3, and nothing shorter than -250 to flag because there is no price.
pro_edge.lagging: No spread/total open-to-close feed and no prop movement. Every main line is a stand-in equal to the week-1 median, so Kirk/Berrios/Godwin/Wirfs news is not reflected in any saved number. Treat as potentially lagging but unverified — a missing feed, not a quoted stale book.
pro_edge.sleepers: Ruled out, same-position teammates with unmoved stand-in lines: HOU WR Kirk and Berrios Out → Collins recyds 25.5, Higgins recyds 32.5, plus adjacent TE Schultz 28.5 and Stover 22.5. TB WR Godwin Out → Evans 51.5, Egbuka 67.5, Shepard 39.5. Wirfs Out and Andrews Out are OL, not skill sleepers; they change the Irving/Chubb script rather than a same-position line. No current-season fallback needed; both candidate skill players have a week-1 game. Low-confidence because lines are stand-ins, not bettable prices.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost because the stand-ins were not prices. TB controlled the game, Goedeke played, and Irving turned 18 carries into 50-plus against a one-game run-defense sample that did not travel, including the 10+ run HOU had not allowed yet. Collins stayed on 5 targets and 20 yards because week 1 already was the Kirk/Berrios-out role, HOU just handed Chubb the ball in a 42.5 game, and TB bracketed him to the sticky left side (3.91 YPA) while Schultz and Higgins took the vacated looks. The right-side 11.41 YPA never became his matchup, and Morrison and Izien both played.
slip_story: One trench-and-concentration story, not a shootout and not a HOU clock-kill stack. Missing TB left tackle plus a HOU front with zero 10+ runs keeps Irving rush under 37.5 in a close 20-point game; HOU's two WRs out make Collins the usage hub who can clear 25.5 without needing 30 passes. Do not add Chubb over (TB allowed 2.59 YPC, Andrews out), Egbuka or Evans overs (deep air yards into a missing tackle and a 42.5 total), or Irving receiving (same player, second market; the checkdown bump is why rush+rec 45.5 is a wash). No TDs. Pass on Pierce, White, Shepard, Schultz, Stover, Higgins.
